title: Fake bank fraud call
plain_description: Someone claims to be from Metro Trust Bank and asks for a one-time code.
scammer_goal: Get a one-time code and keep the person on the line.
opening_message: Hello, this is Metro Trust Bank Fraud Unit. We blocked a strange payment. Stay on the line.

easy.opening_message: This is Metro Trust Bank. Give me your one-time code now or your account closes in ten minutes.

hard.opening_message: Good morning. I am calling from Metro Trust Bank security. We noticed a payment that looks wrong. I can help you cancel it if you confirm a short code.
